global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, topped with glossy chashu pork and a dark nori sheet. Served in a red-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and smooth texture, slightly angled in the frame.
regions.bowl: Red ceramic bowl with white dragon pattern and gold rim, glossy surface reflecting light.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, rich amber color, glossy surface, visible swirls and floating ingredients.
regions.spoon: A white spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip, showing faint use marks.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green and black, with a rough, irregularly shaped surface and visible textured folds.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-white meat with marbling, slightly curled shape, and glistening surface.
